name: Control Panel
description: Persistent HUD of life-and-system metrics + live task board. Surfaces inline graphs between markdown blocks AND a left-panel HUD in Exec mode (graphs / calendar strip / tasks). Replaces Todoist. Native stack — no Grafana, no Docker. Spec at docs/SPEC.md.

dataDir.description: Directory holding the Control Panel SQLite store. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/data/control-panel/

calendarSync.description: Calendar sync configuration. Default: google.primary at 30 min cadence.

briefingImport.description: If true, the morning briefing's task manifest is auto-imported via control-panel.tasks.import. Default: true.

dataDir.label: Data dir
dataDir.help: Where the Control Panel SQLite store lives.
